name: Ama's Mexican Restaurant
tagline: Fajitas, salsa and sopapillas on North Market Street in Hearne.
about: Ama's Mexican Restaurant at 1647 N Market St serves Tex-Mex with dine-in, takeout and a full bar.
Reviewers keep coming back to the fajitas, salsa and sopapillas, and Ama's also caters.

reviews.name: A guest who booked catering
reviews.text: They catered fajitas for our wedding, and they were a HUGE hit!

sources: Address, phone, 4.1 rating from 859 Google reviews: https://overlookmaps.com/places/amas-authentic-mexican-restuarant-hearne-446877224088065
